prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 合规审查法律条文引用表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "法律名称" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 261px
  col 2: header "条款" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 3: header "条文内容" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 4732px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"将合规审查涉及的法律名称、具体条款和条文内容对应起来，供读者查找法律依据。","reading":"读者先按法律名称定位，再通过条款核对具体出处，最后阅读同一行的条文内容；长条文会形成较高的行，为法律名称换行提供空间。","groups":["法律名称与条款共同构成引用出处，应便于连续扫描和对应。","条文内容是被引用的正文，与同一行的出处配合阅读，但需要更多宽度容纳长文本。"],"keep_intact":["条款编号应尽可能保持完整，避免数字与“第”“条”分离。","法律名称中的书名号和名称应尽可能保持清晰、易于辨认。","条文中的法律术语和标点关系应保持可读。"],"may_wrap":["法律名称可在汉字之间自然换行，较高的正文行通常能吸收这些换行。","条文正文可自然换行，但过窄会增加阅读负担。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [80, 90, 189] · table 360×3138px · row heights [60, 757, 385, 385, 618, 478, 455] · column headers wrapped 1/3 · tallest cell 32 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [80, 110, 169] · table 360×3440px · row heights [60, 827, 408, 432, 687, 525, 501] · column headers wrapped 1/3 · tallest cell 35 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [75, 144, 140] · table 360×4370px · row heights [60, 1083, 525, 548, 873, 664, 618] · column headers wrapped 1/3 · tallest cell 46 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"正文列在三稿中最宽，条文的行长和整表高度相对合理；法律名称、条款与正文的对应关系清楚。","problems":"法律名称切成很短的片段，表头“法律名称”也换成两行；较长的条款编号被拆开，查找出处时需要跨行辨认。","cause":"法律名称列80px，仅有59px文本宽度；条款列90px，仅有69px文本宽度，容不下最长编号。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"条款列较宽，多数编号可以保持完整，出处扫描较顺畅；正文仍保持可连续阅读的宽度。","problems":"法律名称依然碎裂，表头仍换行；最长条款编号仍分成两行。正文比r1A更窄，换行和行高明显增加，条款列下方则留下更多空白。","cause":"法律名称列仍为80px；条款列增至110px仍不足以容纳最长编号，而正文列缩至169px，只有148px文本宽度。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"条款编号能保持完整，便于准确核对引用出处。","problems":"法律名称最为碎裂，正文每行很短、段落过长，整表高度显著增加；宽大的条款列在大部分行中留下大量空白，列间比例失衡。","cause":"条款列144px为容纳最长编号付出了较大宽度代价，法律名称列仅75px，正文列仅140px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-source","widths":[90,85,184],"change":"从条款列移出5px、从正文列移出5px给法律名称，使四字表头保持一行并改善名称辨认；接受最长条款换行，为正文保留较宽行长。"},{"name":"body-priority","widths":[81,75,203],"change":"将法律名称列调至足以容纳四字表头的宽度，压缩条款列以扩大正文；检验正文阅读节奏的改善是否值得较多的条款换行。"},{"name":"intact-citation","widths":[81,144,134],"change":"保留足以容纳最长条款编号的条款列，并将法律名称列增至可容纳完整表头；用于检验出处完整性优先时，正文进一步变窄是否仍可接受。"}]}
